title: The reclaim launch resolved on spawn, before the Linux program joined its cgroup and dropped root, so a crash could prove an empty cgroup while the old program still ran
resolution: The program writes ready after it joins its cgroup and drops identity, and launch resolves only on that signal or fails as unavailable; host and worker image tests hold the program before its cgroup.

title: The crash tests threw in process and reopened, running the abandon cleanup that a real kill skips, and WS10.after had no recovery case
resolution: Each of the 13 crash points WS5.before to WS10.after now kills a separate worker process by SIGKILL, so no abandon cleanup runs, and a new worker recovers; WS10.after has its own case and tasks.md states the coverage.

title: The Linux test of a program without go used a checkout and a file the execution account could not change, so a program ignoring go would also pass
resolution: The Linux test uses a checkout and a 0600 file the execution account made, a program that ignores go changes it as a control, and the exit code 3 is read from a FIFO for the timeout and the dead worker.

title: The Linux tests took the first process in the cgroup as ready before it dropped root, and the short go window could end before polling saw the program
resolution: The uid checks follow the readiness signal, the timeout case waits for the reported exit code instead of polling a short state, and processesOf skips a process that exits while it is read.

title: The no-secret test scanned only results and data root files, not the captured Git output or the output of prepare, remote read, and push
resolution: The test records the runner's scrubbed output, the worker's stdout and stderr, every Git argv, results, and data root files for prepare, remote read, and push, the push also against the echoing remote.

title: The spec delta did not modify the requirements that record the containment before the program starts, which Q3 relaxed
resolution: MODIFIED Reclaim program containment and Reclaim program on one account record the containment after readiness and before go, with the 60 s bound and the exit when the worker dies; contract step 7 matches.

title: The new host hand-off tests and conformance runs did not bound Git repository discovery, so a .git in an ancestor of TMPDIR changed them
resolution: Not reproduced: no fixture or adapter Git process runs where discovery reaches an ancestor; all 189 host adapter tests pass with the default TMPDIR and with TMPDIR inside a valid Git repository.

title: The hand-off record parser accepted a record without the containment key as one without containment
resolution: The parser requires the containment key and treats only an explicit null as none; a negative parser test covers a record without the key.

title: The reclaim launch waits for the program's ready signal without a bound, so a program that hangs before it holds the worker's slot forever
resolution: The launch abandons a program not ready within RECLAIM_READY_BOUND_MS, 60 s and injectable, and fails unavailable; contract step 7 and the spec state it; a host test fails before the fix.

title: Hand-off and reclaim of one workspace are not serialized, so a repeated hand-off can reopen a checkout after a reclaim removed its record
resolution: Hand-off, reclaim, and remove of one workspace run in a chain per workspace directory with the root chain inside; an interleaving test fails before the fix.

title: The separate-account conformance run selects cases by name and misses the configuration rewrite case that hands off and reclaims
resolution: The whole conformance suite runs a second time with a simulated separate account, 26 cases each.

title: The Linux tests read only the real uid, so removing the supplementary group drop or a gid switch would pass them
resolution: The Linux tests require uid and gid 10003 in all four fields and no supplementary group; they failed with setgroups removed.

title: The Linux suite never checks that it runs with only the setuid, setgid, and kill capabilities
resolution: The Linux suite checks that CapBnd and CapEff hold only CAP_KILL, CAP_SETGID, and CAP_SETUID.

title: After go the worker waits for the program's exit without a bound, so a hanging program holds the slot with no report
resolution: Coordinator decision: a program running RECLAIM_RUN_BOUND_MS, 10 min, after go is recorded as failed and left running; contract step 7 leaves its cleanup to 16e.

title: The surviving program test still takes a populated cgroup as ready before it writes cgroup.kill, the rest of pass 1 finding 4
resolution: The killed-program test waits until the record names the containment before it writes cgroup.kill.

title: The Linux tests read the exit code FIFO without a bound, so a program that never exits hangs the suite
resolution: The Linux tests that read a FIFO have a 60 s test timeout.

title: The modified Reclaim program containment requirement dropped the same identity exception, the kept hand-off of a failed program, and the reconciliation report
resolution: The requirement again names the same identity exception, the report at the bound, and the kept hand-off of a failed program.

title: The scenario Reclaim containment at start holds two WHEN and THEN pairs after the crash re-run was folded into it
resolution: The crash re-run is its own scenario, Crash before the failure is recorded.

title: The spec states mode 0660 for the repository configuration, but the umask still applies to the file the code creates
resolution: The temporary configuration file is set to 0660 before the rename; a test under umask 0022 fails before the fix.

title: No run shows that the concurrent hand-off case fails without the chain, and the chain shared across adapters of one process is untested
resolution: A test races two adapters of one process; with the root chain bypassed it and the conformance case fail.

title: The hand-off crash tests at WS5.after and WS6 do not check the Git refusal and the completing reclaim that the spec scenario names
resolution: The hand-off crash tests at WS5.after and WS6 check the inspect refusal and a completing reclaim.

title: The proposal lists only the configuration rewrite as modified, not the two reclaim program requirements
resolution: The proposal lists both modified reclaim requirements.

title: The verification record splits the 35 tests as 27 conformance and 7 section 13 tests instead of 26 and 8
resolution: The record now splits the 35 tests as 26 conformance cases and 8 section 13 tests.

title: Design decision 11 still describes the secret test as results and data root files only
resolution: Decision 11 names every channel that the secret test observes.

title: A hand-off test still says the containment is recorded before the program starts, not after its readiness
resolution: The test is renamed to say the containment is recorded once the program is ready and before go.

title: The local installation guide does not list make verify-linux-git-workspace or installation.sh build-worker
resolution: The local installation guide lists make verify-linux-git-workspace and its build-worker image.

title: build_worker in the installation script copies build except for one line
resolution: build and build_worker call one helper, build_stages; the installation script tests pass unchanged.

title: A failed launch, an abandoned program, and a failed program each leave an empty reclaim cgroup that nothing releases
resolution: A failed Linux launch removes its cgroup if empty and an abandoned program's proven-empty containment is freed; 16e reconciliation frees a failed program's cgroup.
